proposals.evidence: Each slash-separated response is independently attested with this meaning in the same survey language and reviewed family: kan (f_jkqfyf4nua3lq), kaṇ (f_2lbw5ipityvyu). Prakrit kaṇṇa corresponds to Hindi, Old Marwari, Gujarati and Marathi kān ‘ear’ in CDIAL. The local dental/retroflex nasal and variable written vowel length fit this inherited family. The original alternatives remain one source record with one shared-family assignment; the slash does not represent compound components. Full evidence for every alternative is retained in alternant-candidates.json.
